A higher-draw pairwise MC is the most targeted remaining computation to determine whether uncertainty could reasonably overturn confidence in the industrial recommendation or merely quantify residual risk. Broader MC or lever tests have lower expected decision value because all nominal candidates are already optimized and parity is unreachable on the frozen descriptor manifold.
